name: Bajra Vegetable Khichdi
category: Healthy Rice, Millet and Grain Dishes
ingredients: ⅓ cup coarse bajra (pearl millet), rinsed and soaked 2 hours
1 tsp ginger and 2 garlic cloves, minced
1 extra cup non-starchy vegetables (spinach, cabbage or green beans), chopped
steps: Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, and add ginger and garlic.
Add the extra chopped vegetables together with the other vegetables.
Add the drained bajra, moong dal, vegetables, turmeric and salt.
Add the water and pressure-cook for 4–5 whistles until soft.
Mash lightly and adjust with hot water.
note: A warming winter dish from Rajasthan; bajra is rich in iron and fibre.
